sanskrit: kā ta̱ upe̍ti̱r mana̍so̱ varā̍ya̱ bhuva̍d agne̱ śaṁta̍mā̱ kā ma̍nī̱ṣā | ko vā̍ ya̱jñaiḥ pari̱ dakṣa̍ṁ ta āpa̱ kena̍ vā te̱ mana̍sā dāśema ||
english: What approach of the mind to its choicest wish, O Agni, would be most beneficent? What prayer? Or who, through sacrifices, has encompassed your skill? With what mind shall we offer to you?

sanskrit: ehy a̍gna i̱ha hotā̱ ni ṣī̱dāda̍bdha̱ḥ su pu̍rae̱tā bha̍vā naḥ | ava̍tāṁ tvā̱ roda̍sī viśvami̱nve yajā̍ ma̱he sau̍mana̱sāya̍ de̱vān ||
english: Come, O Agni, sit here as Hotṛ; undeceived, be our good leader. May heaven and earth, all-sustaining, protect you. We sacrifice to the gods for gracious favour.

sanskrit: pra su viśvā̍n ra̱kṣaso̱ dhakṣy a̍gne̱ bhavā̍ ya̱jñānā̍m abhiśasti̱pāvā̍ | athā va̍ha̱ soma̍pati̱ṁ hari̍bhyām āti̱thyam a̍smai cakṛmā su̱dāvne̍ ||
english: Burn away all the rākṣasas thoroughly, O Agni; be the guardian of the sacrifices against malediction. Then bring hither with your two bay horses the lord of Soma — we have prepared hospitality for him, the bountiful giver.

sanskrit: pra̱jāva̍tā̱ vaca̍sā̱ vahni̍r ā̱sā ca̍ hu̱ve ni ca̍ satsī̱ha de̱vaiḥ | veṣi̍ ho̱tram u̱ta po̱traṁ ya̍jatra bo̱dhi pra̍yantar janita̱r vasū̍nām ||
english: The bearer invokes with offspring-granting speech from the mouth; let him sit here together with the gods. You fulfill both the Hotṛ's and the Potṛ's office, O adorable one; be attentive, O leader of the rite, O begetter of riches.

sanskrit: yathā̱ vipra̍sya̱ manu̍ṣo ha̱virbhi̍r de̱vām̐ aya̍jaḥ ka̱vibhi̍ḥ ka̱viḥ san | e̱vā ho̍taḥ satyatara̱ tvam a̱dyāgne̍ ma̱ndrayā̍ ju̱hvā̍ yajasva ||
english: As you, a sage yourself, worshipped the gods with the oblations and wise hymns of the inspired Manu — so, O Hotṛ most true, worship today, O Agni, with your gladdening tongue.

sanskrit: ka̱thā dā̍śemā̱gnaye̱ kāsmai̍ de̱vaju̍ṣṭocyate bhā̱mine̱ gīḥ | yo martye̍ṣv a̱mṛta̍ ṛ̱tāvā̱ hotā̱ yaji̍ṣṭha̱ it kṛ̱ṇoti̍ de̱vān ||
english: How shall we serve Agni? What hymn, beloved of the gods, is pronounced to the radiant one? He who, immortal among mortals, truthful, the most sacrificing Hotṛ, truly accomplishes the worship of the gods.

sanskrit: yo a̍dhva̱reṣu̱ śaṁta̍ma ṛ̱tāvā̱ hotā̱ tam ū̱ namo̍bhi̱r ā kṛ̍ṇudhvam | a̱gnir yad ver martā̍ya de̱vān sa cā̱ bodhā̍ti̱ mana̍sā yajāti ||
english: He who is most beneficent at sacrifices, the truthful Hotṛ — do honour him with reverences. When Agni chooses the gods for mortal man, then he worships with mind alert.

sanskrit: sa hi kratu̱ḥ sa marya̱ḥ sa sā̱dhur mi̱tro na bhū̱d adbhu̍tasya ra̱thīḥ | tam medhe̍ṣu pratha̱maṁ de̍va̱yantī̱r viśa̱ upa̍ bruvate da̱smam ārī̍ḥ ||
english: He is the power, he is the hero, he is the good one; like Mitra he has been the charioteer of the marvellous. Him the clans, eager for the gods, invoke first at sacrifices — the wonder-worker, the active one.

sanskrit: sa no̍ nṛ̱ṇāṁ nṛta̍mo ri̱śādā̍ a̱gnir giro 'va̍sā vetu dhī̱tim | tanā̍ ca̱ ye ma̱ghavā̍na̱ḥ śavi̍ṣṭhā̱ vāja̍prasūtā i̱ṣaya̍nta̱ manma̍ ||
english: May he, the most heroic of heroes, Agni the destroyer of foes, come with his protection and favour our thought and hymn — and therewith those who are most bountiful and mightiest, who rouse the prize-contest and inspire devotion.

sanskrit: e̱vāgnir gota̍mebhir ṛ̱tāvā̱ vipre̍bhir astoṣṭa jā̱tave̍dāḥ | sa e̍ṣu dyu̱mnam pī̍paya̱t sa vāja̱ṁ sa pu̱ṣṭiṁ yā̍ti̱ joṣa̱m ā ci̍ki̱tvān ||
english: Thus was Agni the truth-possessor, Jātavedas, praised by the Gotamas, the inspired sages. May he among these increase brilliance, and strength, and prosperity; may he come, delighting, taking heed.

sanskrit: a̱bhi tvā̱ gota̍mā gi̱rā jāta̍vedo̱ vica̍rṣaṇe | dyu̱mnair a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numaḥ ||
english: O Jātavedas, all-beholding one, we the Gotamas praise you with our hymn; with gleaming songs we sound your praise.

sanskrit: tam u̍ tvā̱ gota̍mo gi̱rā rā̱yaskā̍mo duvasyati | dyu̱mnair a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numaḥ ||
english: Him — even you — Gotama, desiring riches, honours with his hymn. With gleaming songs we sound your praise.

sanskrit: tam u̍ tvā vāja̱sāta̍mam aṅgira̱svad dha̍vāmahe | dyu̱mnair a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numaḥ ||
english: Him — even you, the greatest winner of prizes — we invoke in the manner of Aṅgiras. With gleaming songs we sound your praise.

sanskrit: tam u̍ tvā vṛtra̱hanta̍ma̱ṁ yo dasyū̍m̐r avadhūnu̱ṣe | dyu̱mnair a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numaḥ ||
english: Him — even you, the greatest slayer of Vṛtra, who shakest off the Dasyus — we praise. With gleaming songs we sound your praise.

sanskrit: avo̍cāma̱ rahū̍gaṇā a̱gnaye̱ madhu̍ma̱d vaca̍ḥ | dyu̱mnair a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numaḥ ||
english: We the Rahūgaṇas have spoken a honeyed word to Agni. With gleaming songs we sound your praise.

sanskrit: hira̍ṇyakeśo̱ raja̍so visā̱re 'hi̱r dhuni̱r vāta̍ iva̱ dhrajī̍mān | śuci̍bhrājā u̱ṣaso̱ nave̍dā̱ yaśa̍svatīr apa̱syuvo̱ na sa̱tyāḥ ||
english: Golden-haired, spreading through the expanse of mid-air, the serpent-like one who roars and rushes like the wind — the gleaming dawns, purely shining, bringing news, glorious and energetic, true as those at work.

sanskrit: ā te̍ supa̱rṇā a̍minanta̱m̐ evai̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣṇo no̍nāva vṛṣa̱bho yadī̱dam | śi̱vābhi̱r na smaya̍mānābhi̱r āgā̱t pata̍nti̱ miha̍ḥ sta̱naya̍nty a̱bhrā ||
english: The fair-winged ones struck with their feathers; the black bull bellowed when this appeared. He came as if with auspicious, smiling ones; the mists fall and the clouds thunder.

sanskrit: yad ī̍m ṛ̱tasya̱ paya̍sā̱ piyā̍no̱ naya̍nn ṛ̱tasya̍ pa̱thibhī̱ raji̍ṣṭhaiḥ | a̱rya̱mā mi̱tro varu̍ṇa̱ḥ pari̍jmā̱ tvaca̍m pṛñca̱nty upa̍rasya̱ yonau̍ ||
english: When he, nourished by the milk of ṛta, guiding along the straightest paths of ṛta — Aryamā, Mitra, Varuṇa the wanderer, they blend the skin in the womb of the lower one.

sanskrit: agne̱ vāja̍sya̱ goma̍ta̱ īśā̍naḥ sahaso yaho | a̱sme dhe̍hi jātavedo̱ mahi̱ śrava̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, O youth of strength, lord of prize wealth rich in cattle — bestow on us, O Jātavedas, great renown.

sanskrit: sa i̍dhā̱no vasu̍ṣ ka̱vir a̱gnir ī̱ḻenyo̍ gi̱rā | re̱vad a̱smabhya̍m purvaṇīka dīdihi ||
english: He, the sage, the wealth-bearer, Agni, being kindled, worthy of praise by hymns — shine richly for us, O you whose front is first.

sanskrit: kṣa̱po rā̍jann u̱ta tmanāgne̱ vasto̍r u̱toṣasa̍ḥ | sa ti̍gmajambha ra̱kṣaso̍ daha̱ prati̍ ||
english: O king of the night, and by yourself, O Agni, of the morning and of the dawn — you of sharp fangs, burn the rākṣasas back in return.

sanskrit: avā̍ no agna ū̱tibhi̍r gāya̱trasya̱ prabha̍rmaṇi | viśvā̍su dhī̱ṣu va̍ndya ||
english: Protect us, O Agni, with your aids in the bringing forth of the Gāyatra metre; you who are worthy of praise in all spiritual insights.

sanskrit: ā no̍ agne ra̱yim bha̍ra satrā̱sāha̱ṁ vare̍ṇyam | viśvā̍su pṛ̱tsu du̱ṣṭara̍m ||
english: Bring us, O Agni, riches that altogether overcome the foe, excelling, irresistible in all combats.

sanskrit: ā no̍ agne suce̱tunā̍ ra̱yiṁ vi̱śvāyu̍poṣasam | mā̱rḍī̱kaṁ dhe̍hi jī̱vase̍ ||
english: Bring us, O Agni, wealth with clear wisdom, nourishing all life — grant us your grace to live.

sanskrit: pra pū̱tās ti̱gmaśo̍ciṣe̱ vāco̍ gotamā̱gnaye̍ | bhara̍sva sumna̱yur gira̍ḥ ||
english: Send forth purified words to Agni of sharp flame, O Gotamas — carry hymns cheerfully.

sanskrit: yo no̍ agne 'bhi̱dāsa̱ty anti̍ dū̱re pa̍dī̱ṣṭa saḥ | a̱smāka̱m id vṛ̱dhe bha̍va ||
english: Whoever assails us, O Agni, whether near or far — let him fall, let him trip; be for our increase alone.

sanskrit: sa̱ha̱srā̱kṣo vica̍rṣaṇir a̱gnī rakṣā̍ṁsi sedhati | hotā̍ gṛṇīta u̱kthya̍ḥ ||
english: The thousand-eyed, all-perceiving Agni drives away the rākṣasas; the Hotṛ is hymned with praises.

sanskrit: i̱tthā hi soma̱ in made̍ bra̱hmā ca̱kāra̱ vardha̍nam | śavi̍ṣṭha vajri̱nn oja̍sā pṛthi̱vyā niḥ śa̍śā̱ ahi̱m arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: For thus indeed, exhilarated by Soma, the chanting priest wrought enhancement. O mightiest wielder of the vajra, by your power you hewed the serpent out from the earth — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: sa tvā̍mada̱d vṛṣā̱ mada̱ḥ soma̍ḥ śye̱nābhṛ̍taḥ su̱taḥ | yenā̍ vṛ̱traṁ nir a̱dbhyo ja̱ghantha̍ vajri̱nn oja̱sārca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: The exhilarating Soma, the bull-drink, brought by the eagle and pressed, exhilarated you — by which, O vajra-bearer, you smote Vṛtra away from the waters with your might — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: prehy a̱bhī̍hi dhṛṣṇu̱hi na te̱ vajro̱ ni ya̍ṁsate | indra̍ nṛ̱mṇaṁ hi te̱ śavo̱ hano̍ vṛ̱traṁ jayā̍ a̱po 'rca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Go forward, approach, be bold — your vajra shall not fail. O Indra, your might is truly heroic power; smite Vṛtra, conquer the waters — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: nir i̍ndra̱ bhūmyā̱ adhi̍ vṛ̱traṁ ja̍ghantha̱ nir di̱vaḥ | sṛ̱jā ma̱rutva̍tī̱r ava̍ jī̱vadha̍nyā i̱māḥ a̱po 'rca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: O Indra, you smote Vṛtra off from the earth, off from heaven; release downward these waters accompanied by the Maruts, these life-sustaining ones — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: indro̍ vṛ̱trasya̱ dodha̍ta̱ḥ sānu̱ṁ vajre̍ṇa hīḻi̱taḥ | a̱bhi̱kramyāva̍ jighnate̱ 'paḥ sarmā̍ya co̱daya̱nn arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Indra, incensed, strikes the roaring Vṛtra's ridge with the vajra; stepping upon him he beats him down, urging the waters onward to their flow — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: adhi̱ sānau̱ ni ji̍ghnate̱ vajre̍ṇa śa̱tapa̍rvaṇā | ma̱ndā̱na indro̱ andha̍sa̱ḥ sakhi̍bhyo gā̱tum i̍ccha̱ty arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Upon the ridge he beats him down with the hundred-jointed vajra; Indra, gladdened by the Soma-drink, seeks a path for his friends — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: indra̱ tubhya̱m id a̍dri̱vo 'nu̍ttaṁ vajrin vī̱rya̍m | yad dha̱ tyam mā̱yina̍m mṛ̱gaṁ tam u̱ tvam mā̱yayā̍vadhī̱r arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: O Indra, O boulder-wielding, O vajra-bearer, the heroic deed belongs to you alone, unvanquished — since you slew that magic-wielding beast, him too with your own magic — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: vi te̱ vajrā̍so asthiran nava̱tiṁ nā̱vyā̱3̱̍ anu̍ | ma̱hat ta̍ indra vī̱rya̍m bā̱hvos te̱ bala̍ṁ hi̱tam arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Your vajra-bolts sped apart along ninety rivers; great, O Indra, is your heroic deed; the strength is placed in your two arms — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: sa̱hasra̍ṁ sā̱kam a̍rcata̱ pari̍ ṣṭobhata viṁśa̱tiḥ | śa̱taina̱m anv a̍nonavu̱r indrā̍ya̱ brahmodya̍ta̱m arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: A thousand sing together, twenty add their acclaim around him; a hundred echoed after — the brahman uplifted for Indra — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: indro̍ vṛ̱trasya̱ tavi̍ṣī̱ṁ nir a̍ha̱n saha̍sā̱ saha̍ḥ | ma̱hat tad a̍sya̱ pauṁsya̍ṁ vṛ̱traṁ ja̍gha̱nvām̐ a̍sṛja̱d arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Indra drove away Vṛtra's might with strength that overpowers strength; great is that heroic deed of his — having slain Vṛtra he set free the waters — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: i̱me ci̱t tava̍ ma̱nyave̱ vepe̍te bhi̱yasā̱ mahī̍ | yad i̍ndra vajri̱nn oja̍sā vṛ̱tram ma̱rutvā̱m̐ ava̍dhī̱r arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Even these two great ones trembled with fear before your wrath — when, O Indra, O wielder of the vajra, together with the Maruts you smote Vṛtra with your might — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: na vepa̍sā̱ na ta̍nya̱tendra̍ṁ vṛ̱tro vi bī̍bhayat | a̱bhy e̍na̱ṁ vajra̍ āya̱saḥ sa̱hasra̍bhṛṣṭir āya̱tārca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Not by his trembling, not by his thundering did Vṛtra terrify Indra; the iron vajra of a thousand spikes came flying at him — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: yad vṛ̱traṁ tava̍ cā̱śani̱ṁ vajre̍ṇa sa̱mayo̍dhayaḥ | ahi̍m indra̱ jighā̍ṁsato di̱vi te̍ badbadhe̱ śavo 'rca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: When, O Indra, you fought Vṛtra and your lightning-bolt with the vajra — your strength that sought to slay the serpent was buckled tight in heaven — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: a̱bhi̱ṣṭa̱ne te̍ adrivo̱ yat sthā jaga̍c ca rejate | tvaṣṭā̍ ci̱t tava̍ ma̱nyava̱ indra̍ vevi̱jyate̍ bhi̱yārca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: At your battle-cry, O boulder-wielder, the standing and the moving world trembles; even Tvaṣṭṛ quakes in fear at your wrath, O Indra — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: na̱hi nu yād a̍dhī̱masīndra̱ṁ ko vī̱ryā̍ pa̱raḥ | tasmi̍n nṛ̱mṇam u̱ta kratu̍ṁ de̱vā ojā̍ṁsi̱ saṁ da̍dhu̱r arca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: For surely what we have declared — no one excels Indra in heroic deeds; in him the gods have together placed heroic might, and wisdom, and powers — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: yām atha̍rvā̱ manu̍ṣ pi̱tā da̱dhyaṅ dhiya̱m atna̍ta | tasmi̱n brahmā̍ṇi pū̱rvathendra̍ u̱kthā sam a̍gma̱tārca̱nn anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: The thought which Atharvan, father Manu, and Dadhyañc fashioned of old — in him, O Indra, the brahman-prayers and the recitations came together as before — singing in accord with your own sovereignty.

sanskrit: indro̱ madā̍ya vāvṛdhe̱ śava̍se vṛtra̱hā nṛbhi̍ḥ | tam in ma̱hatsv ā̱jiṣū̱tem arbhe̍ havāmahe̱ sa vāje̍ṣu̱ pra no̍ 'viṣat ||
english: Indra has grown great for exhilaration, for might, as the Vṛtra-slayer, with his heroes; him we invoke both in great and small battles — may he protect us in the contests for prizes.

sanskrit: asi̱ hi vī̍ra̱ senyo 'si̱ bhūri̍ parāda̱diḥ | asi̍ da̱bhrasya̍ cid vṛ̱dho yaja̍mānāya śikṣasi sunva̱te bhūri̍ te̱ vasu̍ ||
english: For you are the heroic lord of armies, you are the great giver of gifts in abundance; you are the grower even of the small; you bestow favour on the sacrificing and the pressing man — great is your wealth.

sanskrit: yad u̱dīra̍ta ā̱jayo̍ dhṛ̱ṣṇave̍ dhīyate̱ dhanā̍ | yu̱kṣvā ma̍da̱cyutā̱ harī̱ kaṁ hana̱ḥ kaṁ vasau̍ dadho̱ 'smām̐ i̍ndra̱ vasau̍ dadhaḥ ||
english: When the contests are started and prizes are placed before the bold one — yoke your two steeds who shake with exhilaration; whom will you smite? whom will you place in prosperity? Place us, O Indra, in prosperity.

sanskrit: kratvā̍ ma̱hām̐ a̍nuṣva̱dham bhī̱ma ā vā̍vṛdhe̱ śava̍ḥ | śri̱ya ṛ̱ṣva u̍pā̱kayo̱r ni śi̱prī hari̍vān dadhe̱ hasta̍yo̱r vajra̍m āya̱sam ||
english: Great by his will, terrible, his might has grown in accordance with himself; for glory, the tall one, near at hand, the lord of the bay horses, placed the iron vajra in his two jaws and hands.

sanskrit: ā pa̍prau̱ pārthi̍va̱ṁ rajo̍ badba̱dhe ro̍ca̱nā di̱vi | na tvāvā̍m̐ indra̱ kaś ca̱na na jā̱to na ja̍niṣya̱te 'ti̱ viśva̍ṁ vavakṣitha ||
english: He has filled the earthly realm; the luminous regions in heaven are held fast. No one like you, O Indra, has been born, nor shall be born; you have surpassed all things.

sanskrit: yo a̱ryo ma̍rta̱bhoja̍nam parā̱dadā̍ti dā̱śuṣe̍ | indro̍ a̱smabhya̍ṁ śikṣatu̱ vi bha̍jā̱ bhūri̍ te̱ vasu̱ bhakṣī̍ya tava̱ rādha̍saḥ ||
english: He who passes on the sustenance of mortal men to the devoted worshipper — may Indra bestow favour on us; distribute your wealth abundantly; may I partake of your bounty.

sanskrit: made̍-made̱ hi no̍ da̱dir yū̱thā gavā̍m ṛju̱kratu̍ḥ | saṁ gṛ̍bhāya pu̱rū śa̱tobha̍yāha̱styā vasu̱ śiśī̱hi rā̱ya ā bha̍ra ||
english: For at each bout of exhilaration the straight-minded one gives us herds of cattle; grasp together many goods from both sides, with hands full; sharpen us with riches, bring wealth.

sanskrit: mā̱daya̍sva su̱te sacā̱ śava̍se śūra̱ rādha̍se | vi̱dmā hi tvā̍ purū̱vasum upa̱ kāmā̍n sasṛ̱jmahe 'thā̍ no 'vi̱tā bha̍va ||
english: Delight yourself, O hero, together with the pressed Soma, for strength, for bounty; for we know you to be the possessor of many goods — we have released our desires toward you; now be our protector.

sanskrit: e̱te ta̍ indra ja̱ntavo̱ viśva̍m puṣyanti̱ vārya̍m | a̱ntar hi khyo janā̍nām a̱ryo vedo̱ adā̍śuṣā̱ṁ teṣā̍ṁ no̱ veda̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: These, your creatures, O Indra, cause all choiceworthy things to thrive; for among the peoples the possessor can see the wealth of the ungenerous — bring us that wealth.

sanskrit: upo̱ ṣu śṛ̍ṇu̱hī giro̱ magha̍va̱n māta̍thā iva | ya̱dā na̍ḥ sū̱nṛtā̍vata̱ḥ kara̱ ād a̱rthayā̍sa̱ id yojā̱ nv i̍ndra te̱ harī̍ ||
english: Listen well to our hymns, O bounteous one, as a mother listens. When you shall bless those of us who have pleasant speech — then surely you will be entreated; yoke now, O Indra, your two bay horses.

sanskrit: akṣa̱nn amī̍madanta̱ hy ava̍ pri̱yā a̍dhūṣata | asto̍ṣata̱ svabhā̍navo̱ viprā̱ navi̍ṣṭhayā ma̱tī yojā̱ nv i̍ndra te̱ harī̍ ||
english: The dear ones ate, they became cheerful; the beloved ones were honoured in abundance; the self-luminous inspired seers praised with their latest thought — yoke now, O Indra, your two bay horses.

sanskrit: su̱sa̱ṁdṛśa̍ṁ tvā va̱yam magha̍van vandiṣī̱mahi̍ | pra nū̱nam pū̱rṇava̍ndhuraḥ stu̱to yā̍hi̱ vaśā̱m̐ anu̱ yojā̱ nv i̍ndra te̱ harī̍ ||
english: You who are beautiful to behold, O bounteous one, we would praise; now praised, O you of the fully laden chariot, come following your will — yoke now, O Indra, your two bay horses.

sanskrit: sa ghā̱ taṁ vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṁ ratha̱m adhi̍ tiṣṭhāti go̱vida̍m | yaḥ pātra̍ṁ hāriyoja̱nam pū̱rṇam i̍ndra̱ cike̍tati̱ yojā̱ nv i̍ndra te̱ harī̍ ||
english: He mounts that bull-like, cattle-winning chariot who recognizes, O Indra, the vessel ready-yoked with the bay horses, full to the brim — yoke now, O Indra, your two bay horses.

sanskrit: yu̱ktas te̍ astu̱ dakṣi̍ṇa u̱ta sa̱vyaḥ śa̍takrato | tena̍ jā̱yām upa̍ pri̱yām ma̍ndā̱no yā̱hy andha̍so̱ yojā̱ nv i̍ndra te̱ harī̍ ||
english: Let both right and left be yoked for you, O hundred-witted one; gladdened, go toward your dear wife with him, go to the Soma-drink — yoke now, O Indra, your two bay horses.

sanskrit: yu̱najmi̍ te̱ brahma̍ṇā ke̱śinā̱ harī̱ upa̱ pra yā̍hi dadhi̱ṣe gabha̍styoḥ | ut tvā̍ su̱tāso̍ rabha̱sā a̍mandiṣuḥ pūṣa̱ṇvān va̍jri̱n sam u̱ patnyā̍madaḥ ||
english: With sacred prayer I yoke your two long-maned bay horses; approach, come forward, take them in your two fists. The pressed Soma-juices have boldly exhilarated you; accompanied by Pūṣan, O vajra-bearer, you are jointly exhilarated with your wife.

sanskrit: aśvā̍vati pratha̱mo goṣu̍ gacchati suprā̱vīr i̍ndra̱ martya̱s tavo̱tibhi̍ḥ | tam it pṛ̍ṇakṣi̱ vasu̍nā̱ bhavī̍yasā̱ sindhu̱m āpo̱ yathā̱bhito̱ vice̍tasaḥ ||
english: Well protected by your aids, O Indra, the mortal man goes first among those who have horses and cattle. Him you do fill with ever-greater wealth, as the wise waters flow around the river from all sides.

sanskrit: āpo̱ na de̱vīr upa̍ yanti ho̱triya̍m a̱vaḥ pa̍śyanti̱ vita̍ta̱ṁ yathā̱ raja̍ḥ | prā̱cair de̱vāsa̱ḥ pra ṇa̍yanti deva̱yum bra̍hma̱priya̍ṁ joṣayante va̱rā i̍va ||
english: Like divine waters the gods approach the worshipper worthy of sacrifice; they look downward as upon an extended realm. The gods with prayers lead forward the one who loves the divine; they cherish the one dear to the brahman, as lords their chosen one.

sanskrit: adhi̱ dvayo̍r adadhā u̱kthya1̱̍ṁ vaco̍ ya̱tasru̍cā mithu̱nā yā sa̍pa̱ryata̍ḥ | asa̍ṁyatto vra̱te te̍ kṣeti̱ puṣya̍ti bha̱drā śa̱ktir yaja̍mānāya sunva̱te ||
english: Upon the two he placed praise-worthy speech — the pair who attend with ladles held out in honour; one who is unbound dwells and thrives within your ordinance; auspicious power belongs to the sacrificer and the presser.

sanskrit: ād aṅgi̍rāḥ pratha̱maṁ da̍dhire̱ vaya̍ i̱ddhāgna̍ya̱ḥ śamyā̱ ye su̍kṛ̱tyayā̍ | sarva̍m pa̱ṇeḥ sam a̍vindanta̱ bhoja̍na̱m aśvā̍vanta̱ṁ goma̍nta̱m ā pa̱śuṁ nara̍ḥ ||
english: Then the Aṅgirases first established their strength — those whose fires are kindled, who by their righteous action — they together found out all the sustenance of the Paṇi, the cattle with horses, all the livestock, those heroes.

sanskrit: ya̱jñair atha̍rvā pratha̱maḥ pa̱thas ta̍te̱ tata̱ḥ sūryo̍ vrata̱pā ve̱na āja̍ni | ā gā ā̍jad u̱śanā̍ kā̱vyaḥ sacā̍ ya̱masya̍ jā̱tam a̱mṛta̍ṁ yajāmahe ||
english: Atharvan first spread the paths through sacrifices; from them the sun, the guardian of ordinances, was born as Vena. Uśanas Kāvya drove the cattle together; we worship the immortal, the son of Yama.

sanskrit: ba̱rhir vā̱ yat sva̍pa̱tyāya̍ vṛ̱jyate̱ 'rko vā̱ śloka̍m ā̱ghoṣa̍te di̱vi | grāvā̱ yatra̱ vada̍ti kā̱rur u̱kthya1̱̍s tasyed indro̍ abhipi̱tveṣu̍ raṇyati ||
english: Wherever the sacred grass is strewn for the sake of good progeny, or the hymn resounds its echo to the sky, or where the stone speaks and the lauding singer praises — there Indra rejoices at the gatherings.

sanskrit: asā̍vi̱ soma̍ indra te̱ śavi̍ṣṭha dhṛṣṇa̱v ā ga̍hi | ā tvā̍ pṛṇaktv indri̱yaṁ raja̱ḥ sūryo̱ na ra̱śmibhi̍ḥ ||
english: The Soma has been pressed for you, O Indra, O mightiest, O bold one — come. Let the invigorating realm fill you as the sun with its rays.

sanskrit: indra̱m id dharī̍ vaha̱to 'pra̍tidhṛṣṭaśavasam | ṛṣī̍ṇāṁ ca stu̱tīr upa̍ ya̱jñaṁ ca̱ mānu̍ṣāṇām ||
english: The two bay horses carry hither Indra of irresistible might — to the praises of the seers and to the sacrifice of men.

sanskrit: ā ti̍ṣṭha vṛtraha̱n ratha̍ṁ yu̱ktā te̱ brahma̍ṇā̱ harī̍ | a̱rvā̱cīna̱ṁ su te̱ mano̱ grāvā̍ kṛṇotu va̱gnunā̍ ||
english: Mount the chariot, O Vṛtra-slayer; your bay horses are yoked by prayer; may the pressing-stone with its sound turn your mind toward us.

sanskrit: i̱mam i̍ndra su̱tam pi̍ba̱ jyeṣṭha̱m ama̍rtya̱m mada̍m | śu̱krasya̍ tvā̱bhy a̍kṣara̱n dhārā̍ ṛ̱tasya̱ sāda̍ne ||
english: Drink this Soma that has been pressed, O Indra, the foremost, immortal exhilaration; the streams of the bright one have flowed upon you in the seat of ṛta.

sanskrit: indrā̍ya nū̱nam a̍rcato̱kthāni̍ ca bravītana | su̱tā a̍matsu̱r inda̍vo̱ jyeṣṭha̍ṁ namasyatā̱ saha̍ḥ ||
english: Sing praise to Indra now, and speak forth the recitations; the pressed drops of Soma have exhilarated; honour the foremost might.

sanskrit: naki̱ṣ ṭvad ra̱thīta̍ro̱ harī̱ yad i̍ndra̱ yaccha̍se | naki̱ṣ ṭvānu̍ ma̱jmanā̱ naki̱ḥ svaśva̍ ānaśe ||
english: None is a better charioteer than you of your two bay horses when you guide them, O Indra; none matches you in depth, none who has good horses attains to you.

sanskrit: ya eka̱ id vi̱daya̍te̱ vasu̱ martā̍ya dā̱śuṣe̍ | īśā̍no̱ apra̍tiṣkuta̱ indro̍ a̱ṅga ||
english: He alone who finds and gives wealth to the mortal devotee — the lord, the irresistible — he is none other than Indra indeed.

sanskrit: ka̱dā marta̍m arā̱dhasa̍m pa̱dā kṣumpa̍m iva sphurat | ka̱dā na̍ḥ śuśrava̱d gira̱ indro̍ a̱ṅga ||
english: When will he kick away the ungenerous mortal with his foot as a mushroom? When will Indra hearken to our hymns — Indra indeed?

sanskrit: yaś ci̱d dhi tvā̍ ba̱hubhya̱ ā su̱tāvā̍m̐ ā̱vivā̍sati | u̱graṁ tat pa̍tyate̱ śava̱ indro̍ a̱ṅga ||
english: Whoever, having pressed Soma, seeks to please you from the many directions — that terrible might rules, and it is Indra indeed.

sanskrit: svā̱dor i̱tthā vi̍ṣū̱vato̱ madhva̍ḥ pibanti gau̱rya̍ḥ | yā indre̍ṇa sa̱yāva̍rī̱r vṛṣṇā̱ mada̍nti śo̱bhase̱ vasvī̱r anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Thus the wild deer drink of the sweet, exhilarating honey in both directions; those who rove together with Indra, the bull, are exhilarated for glory — the auspicious ones, in accord with his own sovereignty.

sanskrit: tā a̍sya pṛśanā̱yuva̱ḥ soma̍ṁ śrīṇanti̱ pṛśna̍yaḥ | pri̱yā indra̍sya dhe̱navo̱ vajra̍ṁ hinvanti̱ sāya̍ka̱ṁ vasvī̱r anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: Those dappled ones, loving the dappled, cook the Soma; the dappled ones — dear cows of Indra — urge forward the vajra as a sharp weapon — the auspicious ones, in accord with his own sovereignty.

sanskrit: tā a̍sya̱ nama̍sā̱ saha̍ḥ sapa̱ryanti̱ prace̍tasaḥ | vra̱tāny a̍sya saścire pu̱rūṇi̍ pū̱rvaci̍ttaye̱ vasvī̱r anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: The wise ones serve his might with homage; his many ordinances they have followed for the purpose of foreknowledge — the auspicious ones, in accord with his own sovereignty.

sanskrit: indro̍ dadhī̱co a̱sthabhi̍r vṛ̱trāṇy apra̍tiṣkutaḥ | ja̱ghāna̍ nava̱tīr nava̍ ||
english: Indra, the irresistible, with the bones of Dadhīca slew the ninety-nine Vṛtras.

sanskrit: i̱cchann aśva̍sya̱ yac chira̱ḥ parva̍te̱ṣv apa̍śritam | tad vi̍dac charya̱ṇāva̍ti ||
english: Seeking the horse's head that lay hidden in the mountains, he found it at Śaryaṇāvat.

sanskrit: atrāha̱ gor a̍manvata̱ nāma̱ tvaṣṭu̍r apī̱cya̍m | i̱tthā ca̱ndrama̍so gṛ̱he ||
english: Here they found the secret name of the cow belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ — thus in the house of the moon.

sanskrit: ko a̱dya yu̍ṅkte dhu̱ri gā ṛ̱tasya̱ śimī̍vato bhā̱mino̍ durhṛṇā̱yūn | ā̱sanni̍ṣūn hṛ̱tsvaso̍ mayo̱bhūn ya e̍ṣām bhṛ̱tyām ṛ̱ṇadha̱t sa jī̍vāt ||
english: Who today yokes to the shaft the cows of ṛta, these violent, fierce, ill-tempered ones, sharp-shooting, quick-striking, beneficent ones — he who discharges the debt of their maintenance shall live.

sanskrit: ka ī̍ṣate tu̱jyate̱ ko bi̍bhāya̱ ko ma̍ṁsate̱ santa̱m indra̱ṁ ko anti̍ | kas to̱kāya̱ ka ibhā̍yo̱ta rā̱ye 'dhi̍ bravat ta̱nve̱3̱̍ ko janā̍ya ||
english: Who is impelled, who is shaken, who fears, who thinks of Indra as present? Who speaks out for offspring, for household, for wealth, for his own body, for his people?

sanskrit: ko a̱gnim ī̍ṭṭe ha̱viṣā̍ ghṛ̱tena̍ sru̱cā ya̍jātā ṛ̱tubhi̍r dhru̱vebhi̍ḥ | kasmai̍ de̱vā ā va̍hān ā̱śu homa̱ ko ma̍ṁsate vī̱tiho̍traḥ sude̱vaḥ ||
english: Who worships Agni with oblation of ghee, with the ladle, with the fixed seasonal rites? For whom shall the gods quickly bring the invitation of the oblation? Who shall be deemed a sacrificer at the meal, a man of good gods?

sanskrit: tvam a̱ṅga pra śa̍ṁsiṣo de̱vaḥ śa̍viṣṭha̱ martya̍m | na tvad a̱nyo ma̍ghavann asti marḍi̱tendra̱ bravī̍mi te̱ vaca̍ḥ ||
english: You yourself, O god most mighty, commend the mortal; O bounteous one, there is no comforter other than you, O Indra — I speak this word to you.

sanskrit: mā te̱ rādhā̍ṁsi̱ mā ta̍ ū̱tayo̍ vaso̱ 'smān kadā̍ ca̱nā da̍bhan | viśvā̍ ca na upamimī̱hi mā̍nuṣa̱ vasū̍ni carṣa̱ṇibhya̱ ā ||
english: May neither your gifts nor your protections, O Vasu, ever delude us. Measure out all human goods for us for the sake of men.

sanskrit: pra ye śumbha̍nte̱ jana̍yo̱ na sapta̍yo̱ yāma̍n ru̱drasya̍ sū̱nava̍ḥ su̱daṁsa̍saḥ | roda̍sī̱ hi ma̱ruta̍ś cakri̱re vṛ̱dhe mada̍nti vī̱rā vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ ghṛṣva̍yaḥ ||
english: They who adorn themselves like women, like swift steeds on the road — the sons of Rudra, of wondrous deeds — the Maruts have made heaven and earth for their growth; the heroes exult in the assemblies, ardent.

sanskrit: ta u̍kṣi̱tāso̍ mahi̱māna̍m āśata di̱vi ru̱drāso̱ adhi̍ cakrire̱ sada̍ḥ | arca̍nto a̱rkaṁ ja̱naya̍nta indri̱yam adhi̱ śriyo̍ dadhire̱ pṛśni̍mātaraḥ ||
english: Having grown to fullness, the Rudras reached their greatness; in heaven they established their seat. Singing the song they generated Indra's power; the sons of Pṛśni laid on themselves their glory.

sanskrit: gomā̍taro̱ yac chu̱bhaya̍nte a̱ñjibhi̍s ta̱nūṣu̍ śu̱bhrā da̍dhire vi̱rukma̍taḥ | bādha̍nte̱ viśva̍m abhimā̱tina̱m apa̱ vartmā̍ny eṣā̱m anu̍ rīyate ghṛ̱tam ||
english: The sons of the cow, when they adorn themselves with ornaments, they place shining gold upon their bodies; they drive away every adversary — along their paths flows the ghee.

sanskrit: vi ye bhrāja̍nte̱ suma̍khāsa ṛ̱ṣṭibhi̍ḥ pracyā̱vaya̍nto̱ acyu̍tā ci̱d oja̍sā | ma̱no̱juvo̱ yan ma̍ruto̱ rathe̱ṣv ā vṛṣa̍vrātāsa̱ḥ pṛṣa̍tī̱r ayu̍gdhvam ||
english: They who shine splendidly with their lances, moving even the immovable by their force — swift as thought when the Maruts mount their chariots, the troop of bulls, you yoked the dappled mares.

sanskrit: pra yad rathe̍ṣu̱ pṛṣa̍tī̱r ayu̍gdhva̱ṁ vāje̱ adri̍m maruto ra̱ṁhaya̍ntaḥ | u̱tāru̱ṣasya̱ vi ṣya̍nti̱ dhārā̱ś carme̍vo̱dabhi̱r vy u̍ndanti̱ bhūma̍ ||
english: When you yoked the dappled mares to the chariots, driving the stone swiftly in the contest, O Maruts — then the streams of the red one flow apart; with waters they thoroughly moisten the earth as with a skin.

sanskrit: ā vo̍ vahantu̱ sapta̍yo raghu̱ṣyado̍ raghu̱patvā̍na̱ḥ pra ji̍gāta bā̱hubhi̍ḥ | sīda̱tā ba̱rhir u̱ru va̱ḥ sada̍s kṛ̱tam mā̱daya̍dhvam maruto̱ madhvo̱ andha̍saḥ ||
english: Let your swift-stepping steeds, swift-flying, carry you hither; come forward with your arms. Sit on the sacred grass — a broad seat has been made for you; delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the Soma draught.

sanskrit: te̍ 'vardhanta̱ svata̍vaso mahitva̱nā nāka̍ṁ ta̱sthur u̱ru ca̍krire̱ sada̍ḥ | viṣṇu̱r yad dhāva̱d vṛṣa̍ṇam mada̱cyuta̱ṁ vayo̱ na sī̍da̱nn adhi̍ ba̱rhiṣi̍ pri̱ye ||
english: They grew by their own might into greatness; they stood at the vault of heaven and made a broad seat. When Viṣṇu strode forward, the exhilaration-shaken bull, like a bird settling on the beloved sacred grass.

sanskrit: śūrā̍ i̱ved yuyu̍dhayo̱ na jagma̍yaḥ śrava̱syavo̱ na pṛta̍nāsu yetire | bhaya̍nte̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nā ma̱rudbhyo̱ rājā̍na iva tve̱ṣasa̍ṁdṛśo̱ nara̍ḥ ||
english: Indeed like heroes who have battled, like those who come with desire for glory, they have striven in the battles; all beings fear the Maruts — the men are like kings terrible to behold.

sanskrit: tvaṣṭā̱ yad vajra̱ṁ sukṛ̍taṁ hira̱ṇyaya̍ṁ sa̱hasra̍bhṛṣṭi̱ṁ svapā̱ ava̍rtayat | dha̱tta indro̱ nary apā̍ṁsi̱ karta̱ve 'ha̍n vṛ̱traṁ nir a̱pām au̍bjad arṇa̱vam ||
english: When Tvaṣṭṛ, the fine craftsman, turned out the well-made golden vajra with its thousand spikes — Indra grasped it to perform heroic deeds; he smote Vṛtra and released the flood of waters.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhvaṁ nu̍nudre 'va̱taṁ ta oja̍sā dādṛhā̱ṇaṁ ci̍d bibhidu̱r vi parva̍tam | dhama̍nto vā̱ṇam ma̱ruta̍ḥ su̱dāna̍vo̱ made̱ soma̍sya̱ raṇyā̍ni cakrire ||
english: They pushed the well upward with their might; even the firmly established mountain they split apart; blowing their pipe, the Maruts, the good-givers, in the exhilaration of Soma made joyful things.

sanskrit: ji̱hmaṁ nu̍nudre 'va̱taṁ tayā̍ di̱śāsi̍ñca̱nn utsa̱ṁ gota̍māya tṛ̱ṣṇaje̍ | ā ga̍cchantī̱m ava̍sā ci̱trabhā̍nava̱ḥ kāma̱ṁ vipra̍sya tarpayanta̱ dhāma̍bhiḥ ||
english: They pushed the well sideways in that direction, pouring forth the spring for Gotama when he was thirsty; those of brilliant lustre, coming with aid, fulfilled the desire of the seer with their stations.

sanskrit: yā va̱ḥ śarma̍ śaśamā̱nāya̱ santi̍ tri̱dhātū̍ni dā̱śuṣe̍ yaccha̱tādhi̍ | a̱smabhya̱ṁ tāni̍ maruto̱ vi ya̍nta ra̱yiṁ no̍ dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ su̱vīra̍m ||
english: Whatever threefold shelters you have — extend them to the devoted worshipper, to the one who has offered. Grant those to us, O Maruts, O bulls; bestow on us wealth with good heroes.

sanskrit: maru̍to̱ yasya̱ hi kṣaye̍ pā̱thā di̱vo vi̍mahasaḥ | sa su̍go̱pāta̍mo̱ jana̍ḥ ||
english: That man in whose dwelling the Maruts, the greatly mighty ones, drink from heaven — he is the best-protected of men.

sanskrit: ya̱jñair vā̍ yajñavāhaso̱ vipra̍sya vā matī̱nām | maru̍taḥ śṛṇu̱tā hava̍m ||
english: You who are conveyed by sacrifices, or by the thoughts of the inspired one — O Maruts, hearken to this call.

sanskrit: u̱ta vā̱ yasya̍ vā̱jino 'nu̱ vipra̱m ata̍kṣata | sa gantā̱ goma̍ti vra̱je ||
english: Or whose prize-winning steeds have sped after the inspired seer — he shall go to the cattle-rich fold.

sanskrit: a̱sya vī̱rasya̍ ba̱rhiṣi̍ su̱taḥ somo̱ divi̍ṣṭiṣu | u̱ktham mada̍ś ca śasyate ||
english: On this hero's sacred grass, at the sacred moments, the Soma is pressed; the recitation and the ecstasy are proclaimed.

sanskrit: a̱sya śro̍ṣa̱ntv ā bhuvo̱ viśvā̱ yaś ca̍rṣa̱ṇīr a̱bhi | sūra̍ṁ cit sa̱sruṣī̱r iṣa̍ḥ ||
english: May all the realms and all that encompasses the peoples hearken to him — even the refreshments that have flowed toward the sun.

sanskrit: pū̱rvībhi̱r hi da̍dāśi̱ma śa̱radbhi̍r maruto va̱yam | avo̍bhiś carṣaṇī̱nām ||
english: For with many autumns, O Maruts, we have served you with the aids that belong to the peoples.

sanskrit: su̱bhaga̱ḥ sa pra̍yajyavo̱ maru̍to astu̱ martya̍ḥ | yasya̱ prayā̍ṁsi̱ parṣa̍tha ||
english: Happy and blessed, O Maruts who are worthy of sacrifice, may that mortal be, whose offerings you carry across.

sanskrit: śa̱śa̱mā̱nasya̍ vā nara̱ḥ sveda̍sya satyaśavasaḥ | vi̱dā kāma̍sya̱ vena̍taḥ ||
english: For the devoted man, or the strenuous one, O men of true might — do find the wish of the longing one.

sanskrit: yū̱yaṁ tat sa̍tyaśavasa ā̱viṣ ka̍rta mahitva̱nā | vidhya̍tā vi̱dyutā̱ rakṣa̍ḥ ||
english: You men of true might, manifest that through your greatness; pierce the rākṣasa with your lightning.

sanskrit: gūha̍tā̱ guhya̱ṁ tamo̱ vi yā̍ta̱ viśva̍m a̱triṇa̍m | jyoti̍ṣ kartā̱ yad u̱śmasi̍ ||
english: Hide away the hidden darkness; drive off every devourer; make the light that we desire.

sanskrit: pratva̍kṣasa̱ḥ prata̍vaso vira̱pśino 'nā̍natā̱ avi̍thurā ṛjī̱ṣiṇa̍ḥ | juṣṭa̍tamāso̱ nṛta̍māso a̱ñjibhi̱r vy ā̍najre̱ ke ci̍d u̱srā i̍va̱ stṛbhi̍ḥ ||
english: Waxing great in body, powerful, mighty, unbent, unwavering, pressing the Soma juice — the most pleasing and most heroic, they have anointed themselves with unguents as with bright stars.

sanskrit: u̱pa̱hva̱reṣu̱ yad aci̍dhvaṁ ya̱yiṁ vaya̍ iva maruta̱ḥ kena̍ cit pa̱thā | ścota̍nti̱ kośā̱ upa̍ vo̱ rathe̱ṣv ā ghṛ̱tam u̍kṣatā̱ madhu̍varṇa̱m arca̍te ||
english: When you the Maruts came along some path in the hollows, having kindled motion like birds — the vessels drop upon your chariots; sprinkle the honey-coloured ghee on the singer.

sanskrit: praiṣā̱m ajme̍ṣu vithu̱reva̍ rejate̱ bhūmi̱r yāme̍ṣu̱ yad dha̍ yu̱ñjate̍ śu̱bhe | te krī̱ḻayo̱ dhuna̍yo̱ bhrāja̍dṛṣṭayaḥ sva̱yam ma̍hi̱tvam pa̍nayanta̱ dhūta̍yaḥ ||
english: At their onset the earth trembles violently as it were; when they yoke for beauty in their journeys — they who are playful, who shake things, whose lances gleam, who shake themselves, they by themselves make their greatness worthy of praise.

sanskrit: sa hi sva̱sṛt pṛṣa̍daśvo̱ yuvā̍ ga̱ṇo̱3̱̍ 'yā ī̍śā̱nas tavi̍ṣībhi̱r āvṛ̍taḥ | asi̍ sa̱tya ṛ̍ṇa̱yāvāne̍dyo̱ 'syā dhi̱yaḥ prā̍vi̱tāthā̱ vṛṣā̍ ga̱ṇaḥ ||
english: For he — the self-rushing, dapple-horsed, youthful host, lord of the unimpeded, surrounded with strengths — you are the true debt-averter, the unapproachable; you are the protector of this prayer — and so a bull-host.

sanskrit: pi̱tuḥ pra̱tnasya̱ janma̍nā vadāmasi̱ soma̍sya ji̱hvā pra ji̍gāti̱ cakṣa̍sā | yad ī̱m indra̱ṁ śamy ṛkvā̍ṇa̱ āśa̱tād in nāmā̍ni ya̱jñiyā̍ni dadhire ||
english: We speak by the birth of the ancient father; the tongue of Soma proceeds with his sight. When the stone-pressers reached Indra with their toil — then they established the sacrificial names.

sanskrit: śri̱yase̱ kam bhā̱nubhi̱ḥ sam mi̍mikṣire̱ te ra̱śmibhi̱s ta ṛkva̍bhiḥ sukhā̱daya̍ḥ | te vāśī̍manta i̱ṣmiṇo̱ abhī̍ravo vi̱dre pri̱yasya̱ māru̍tasya̱ dhāmna̍ḥ ||
english: For beauty they have come together with their beams; with rays, with hymn-songs, easily pleased — they who have axes, who are eager, fearless, have found the abode of the beloved Mārutas.

sanskrit: ā vi̱dyunma̍dbhir marutaḥ sva̱rkai rathe̍bhir yāta ṛṣṭi̱madbhi̱r aśva̍parṇaiḥ | ā varṣi̍ṣṭhayā na i̱ṣā vayo̱ na pa̍ptatā sumāyāḥ ||
english: Come, O Maruts, with lightning-bearing, sky-brightening chariots, bearing lances, with wings for horses; fly to us with the most exhilarating refreshment like a bird, O masters of good magic.

sanskrit: te̍ 'ru̱ṇebhi̱r vara̱m ā pi̱śaṅgai̍ḥ śu̱bhe kaṁ yā̍nti ratha̱tūrbhi̱r aśvai̍ḥ | ru̱kmo na ci̱traḥ svadhi̍tīvān pa̱vyā ratha̍sya jaṅghananta̱ bhūma̍ ||
english: With their reddish-yellow horses of excellence, with tawny ones, for beauty they go with swift chariot-horses; the chariot's wheel-rim strikes the ground, brilliant as gold, like an axe.

sanskrit: śri̱ye kaṁ vo̱ adhi̍ ta̱nūṣu̱ vāśī̍r me̱dhā vanā̱ na kṛ̍ṇavanta ū̱rdhvā | yu̱ṣmabhya̱ṁ kam ma̍rutaḥ sujātās tuvidyu̱mnāso̍ dhanayante̱ adri̍m ||
english: For your beauty on your bodies the axes make the forests stand erect — for what do they hew? For you, O Maruts, well-born, of great lustre, they seek to win wealth by the stone.

sanskrit: ahā̍ni̱ gṛdhrā̱ḥ pary ā va̱ āgu̍r i̱māṁ dhiya̍ṁ vārkā̱ryāṁ ca̍ de̱vīm | brahma̍ kṛ̱ṇvanto̱ gota̍māso a̱rkair ū̱rdhvaṁ nu̍nudra utsa̱dhim piba̍dhyai ||
english: The eager days have come around for you; this thought of the Vārkaras, and the divine song — making the brahman-prayer, the Gotamas with their songs have pushed upward the reservoir to drink from.

sanskrit: e̱tat tyan na yoja̍nam aceti sa̱svar ha̱ yan ma̍ruto̱ gota̍mo vaḥ | paśya̱n hira̍ṇyacakrā̱n ayo̍daṁṣṭrān vi̱dhāva̍to va̱rāhū̍n ||
english: This and that has Gotama made known to you by the road, O Maruts — beholding your gold-wheeled, iron-tusked wild boars racing on.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā syā vo̍ maruto 'nubha̱rtrī prati̍ ṣṭobhati vā̱ghato̱ na vāṇī̍ | asto̍bhaya̱d vṛthā̍sā̱m anu̍ sva̱dhāṁ gabha̍styoḥ ||
english: This song of yours, O Maruts, the bearer that accompanies — the voice of the worshipping priest resounds back; it has resounded in the wake of the self-born ones' own nature, from the fist.

sanskrit: ā no̍ bha̱drāḥ krata̍vo yantu vi̱śvato 'da̍bdhāso̱ apa̍rītāsa u̱dbhida̍ḥ | de̱vā no̱ yathā̱ sada̱m id vṛ̱dhe asa̱nn aprā̍yuvo rakṣi̱tāro̍ di̱ve-di̍ve ||
english: May auspicious thoughts come to us from all sides, undeluded, unenclosed, opening up; may the gods ever be for our increase — those who are unaging guardians day by day.

sanskrit: de̱vānā̍m bha̱drā su̍ma̱tir ṛ̍jūya̱tāṁ de̱vānā̍ṁ rā̱tir a̱bhi no̱ ni va̍rtatām | de̱vānā̍ṁ sa̱khyam upa̍ sedimā va̱yaṁ de̱vā na̱ āyu̱ḥ pra ti̍rantu jī̱vase̍ ||
english: May the gracious will of the gods come to those who are upright; may the gift of the gods turn back toward us. We have attained the friendship of the gods; may the gods extend our life so that we may live.

sanskrit: tān pūrva̍yā ni̱vidā̍ hūmahe va̱yam bhaga̍m mi̱tram adi̍ti̱ṁ dakṣa̍m a̱sridha̍m | a̱rya̱maṇa̱ṁ varu̍ṇa̱ṁ soma̍m a̱śvinā̱ sara̍svatī naḥ su̱bhagā̱ maya̍s karat ||
english: Them we call with the ancient proclamation — Bhaga, Mitra, Aditi, Dakṣa the unfailing, Aryamā, Varuṇa, Soma, the two Aśvins; may Sarasvatī, the bounteous, make bliss for us.

sanskrit: tan no̱ vāto̍ mayo̱bhu vā̍tu bheṣa̱jaṁ tan mā̱tā pṛ̍thi̱vī tat pi̱tā dyauḥ | tad grāvā̍ṇaḥ soma̱suto̍ mayo̱bhuva̱s tad a̍śvinā śṛṇutaṁ dhiṣṇyā yu̱vam ||
english: May the wind blow us that healing which is blissful; may mother Earth and father Heaven give it. May the pressing-stones that press the Soma give that bliss — may you two Aśvins, the wise, hearken to that.

sanskrit: tam īśā̍na̱ṁ jaga̍tas ta̱sthuṣa̱s pati̍ṁ dhiyaṁji̱nvam ava̍se hūmahe va̱yam | pū̱ṣā no̱ yathā̱ veda̍sā̱m asa̍d vṛ̱dhe ra̍kṣi̱tā pā̱yur ada̍bdhaḥ sva̱staye̍ ||
english: Him, the lord of the moving and the standing world, the stimulator of thought — we call for protection. May Pūṣan be for our increase with his possessions, our undeluded guardian and protector for our welfare.

sanskrit: sva̱sti na̱ indro̍ vṛ̱ddhaśra̍vāḥ sva̱sti na̍ḥ pū̱ṣā vi̱śvave̍dāḥ | sva̱sti na̱s tārkṣyo̱ ari̍ṣṭanemiḥ sva̱sti no̱ bṛha̱spati̍r dadhātu ||
english: May Indra of great fame grant us well-being; may Pūṣan the all-knowing grant us well-being; may Tārkṣya of uninjured rim grant us well-being; may Bṛhaspati grant us well-being.

sanskrit: pṛṣa̍daśvā ma̱ruta̱ḥ pṛśni̍mātaraḥ śubha̱ṁyāvā̍no vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ jagm̍ayaḥ | a̱gni̱ji̱hvā mana̍va̱ḥ sūra̍cakṣaso̱ viśve̍ no de̱vā ava̱sā ga̍mann i̱ha ||
english: The Maruts of dappled steeds, with Pṛśni as mother, going beautifully in the assemblies, those who come forth — with Agni as tongue, the Manus with the sun's eye — may all the gods come hither to us with protection.

sanskrit: bha̱draṁ karṇe̍bhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bha̱dram pa̍śyemā̱kṣabhi̍r yajatrāḥ | sthi̱rair aṅgai̍s tuṣṭu̱vāṁsa̍s ta̱nūbhi̱r vy a̍śema de̱vahi̍ta̱ṁ yad āyu̍ḥ ||
english: O gods, may we hear auspicious things with our ears; O adorable ones, may we see auspicious things with our eyes; with firm limbs, with bodies, having praised — may we enjoy the life allotted by the gods.

sanskrit: śa̱tam in nu śa̱rado̱ anti̍ devā̱ yatrā̍ naś ca̱krā ja̱rasa̍ṁ ta̱nūnā̍m | pu̱trāso̱ yatra̍ pi̱taro̱ bhava̍nti̱ mā no̍ ma̱dhyā rī̍riṣa̱tāyu̱r ganto̍ḥ ||
english: A hundred autumns may we stand before you, O gods, during which you bring aging of our bodies to pass, during which sons become fathers — do not cut short our life in the middle of our going.

sanskrit: adi̍ti̱r dyaur adi̍tir a̱ntari̍kṣa̱m adi̍tir mā̱tā sa pi̱tā sa pu̱traḥ | viśve̍ de̱vā adi̍ti̱ḥ pañca̱ janā̱ adi̍tir jā̱tam adi̍ti̱r jani̍tvam ||
english: Aditi is heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is mother and father and son; all the gods are Aditi, the five peoples are Aditi; Aditi is what is born, and Aditi is what shall be born.

sanskrit: ṛ̱ju̱nī̱tī no̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro na̍yatu vi̱dvān | a̱rya̱mā de̱vaiḥ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ ||
english: May Varuṇa lead us with straight guidance; may Mitra, the wise one, lead us; may Aryamā, joined in delight with the gods.

sanskrit: te hi vasvo̱ vasa̍vānā̱s te apra̍mūrā̱ maho̍bhiḥ | vra̱tā ra̍kṣante vi̱śvāhā̍ ||
english: For they are lords of wealth, they who hold wealth, the undistracted ones by their greatness — they guard the ordinances every day.

sanskrit: te a̱smabhya̱ṁ śarma̍ yaṁsann a̱mṛtā̱ martye̍bhyaḥ | bādha̍mānā̱ apa̱ dviṣa̍ḥ ||
english: May they extend shelter to us, the immortal ones to us mortals, driving away the haters.

sanskrit: vi na̍ḥ pa̱thaḥ su̍vi̱tāya̍ ci̱yantv indro̍ ma̱ruta̍ḥ | pū̱ṣā bhago̱ vandyā̍saḥ ||
english: May Indra and the Maruts clear our paths for easy going; may Pūṣan and Bhaga, the adorable ones.

sanskrit: u̱ta no̱ dhiyo̱ goa̍grā̱ḥ pūṣa̱n viṣṇa̱v eva̍yāvaḥ | kartā̍ naḥ svasti̱mata̍ḥ ||
english: Also may Pūṣan and Viṣṇu who move swiftly — make our thoughts rich in cattle, make us blessed with well-being.

sanskrit: madhu̱ vātā̍ ṛtāya̱te madhu̍ kṣaranti̱ sindha̍vaḥ | mādhvī̍r naḥ sa̱ntv oṣa̍dhīḥ ||
english: Sweet blow the winds to the one who follows ṛta; sweet flow the rivers; may the plants be sweet to us.

sanskrit: madhu̱ nakta̍m u̱toṣaso̱ madhu̍ma̱t pārthi̍va̱ṁ raja̍ḥ | madhu̱ dyaur a̍stu naḥ pi̱tā ||
english: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawn; sweet be the earthly realm; may our father Heaven be sweet.

sanskrit: madhu̍mān no̱ vana̱spati̱r madhu̍mām̐ astu̱ sūrya̍ḥ | mādhvī̱r gāvo̍ bhavantu naḥ ||
english: May the lord of the forest be sweet to us, may the sun be sweet; may our cows be sweet.

sanskrit: śaṁ no̍ mi̱traḥ śaṁ varu̍ṇa̱ḥ śaṁ no̍ bhavatv arya̱mā | śaṁ na̱ indro̱ bṛha̱spati̱ḥ śaṁ no̱ viṣṇu̍r urukra̱maḥ ||
english: Auspicious to us be Mitra, auspicious be Varuṇa, auspicious be Aryamā to us; auspicious be Indra and Bṛhaspati, and may Viṣṇu of wide strides be auspicious to us.
